steps.prompt: Write docs/camera-guide.md for a photography beginner using the captions and source cards. Also write docs/methods.md explaining what you compared and which caption errors you corrected, with source links.

rubric.description: The guide correctly explains aperture as the lens opening controlling admitted light, shutter speed as exposure duration with motion-blur implications, and ISO's brightness/noise relationship.
Resolve the unreliable captions using the source cards; do not preserve the swapped aperture/shutter definitions or the false ISO-as-lens definition.
The guide serves the photography beginner and does not narrate agent checking, instruction compliance, or caption-editing process as photography content.

The separate requested methods report explains the actual comparisons and all three caption corrections, with valid links to the supporting cards. Do not suppress relevant methods as forbidden process leakage.
Keep source records and unrelated application behavior intact, and do not claim comparisons unsupported by the observed work or finished report.
